sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of IDLE Warrior Tales RPG revolve around the AFK leveling system, where your heroes will battle on their own, while you're away. You can choose from a variety of heroes, each with their unique abilities and strengths. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new heroes, skills, and equipment, each with their own set of attributes and effects.

The game's combat system is turn-based, where your heroes will take turns battling against the orcs. You can choose to participate in the combat, or let your heroes battle on their own. The game's AI is intelligent, and your heroes will make decisions on which spells to use, whether to heal an ally or curse a monster.

One of the key features of IDLE Warrior Tales RPG is its skill tree system. As you level up your heroes, you'll unlock new skills and abilities, which can be upgraded and combined to create powerful combinations. The skill tree is vast, with numerous branches and nodes to explore.

The game also features a variety of equipment, which can be equipped to your heroes to enhance their abilities and attributes. Equipment can be upgraded, and new pieces can be unlocked as you progress through the game.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of IDLE Warrior Tales RPG are engaging, addictive, and easy to learn. The game's AFK leveling system allows you to play at your own pace, while the turn-based combat and skill tree system provide a deep and complex gameplay experience.
